# Git Worktree Disjunction & Conflict Pre-Checker

Concurrency hook: checks petgraph and oxc_resolver before authorizing parallel worktrees, ensuring zero AST import collisions.

## Invariants
- REJECT_WORKTREES_WITH_OVERLAPPING_FILES
- CHECK_TRANSITIVE_AST_IMPORTS_DISJUNCTION
- AUTHORIZE_DISJOINT_WORKTREES_ONLY
